answered.sql: SELECT U.description FROM Units U JOIN Apartment_Buildings_Units ABU ON U.id = ABU.unit_id GROUP BY U.id HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT ABU.building_id) = (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Apartment_Buildings)

candidates.meaning: For each apartment building, list all unit descriptions associated with it.
candidates.sql: SELECT ab.name, u.description FROM Apartment_Buildings ab JOIN Apartment_Buildings_Units abu ON ab.id = abu.building_id JOIN Units u ON abu.unit_id = u.id

candidates.meaning: Find the unit descriptions for each apartment building.
candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT ab.name, u.description FROM Apartment_Buildings ab JOIN Apartment_Buildings_Units abu ON ab.id = abu.building_id JOIN Units u ON abu.unit_id = u.id

candidates.meaning: List the unit descriptions for each building, including buildings with no units.
candidates.sql: SELECT ab.name, u.description FROM Apartment_Buildings ab LEFT JOIN Apartment_Buildings_Units abu ON ab.id = abu.building_id LEFT JOIN Units u ON abu.unit_id = u.id

candidates.meaning: Identify the unit descriptions for each building, considering only the first unit per building.
candidates.sql: SELECT ab.name, u.description FROM Apartment_Buildings ab JOIN Apartment_Buildings_Units abu ON ab.id = abu.building_id JOIN Units u ON abu.unit_id = u.id LIMIT 1
